description: Fetch a public https URL, compute SHA-256 of the response body, and report whether it changed vs a prior sha256/etag ($0.01 USDC via x402). Sticky: store sha256 and call again later. Optional previous_sha256, previous_etag, include_body_if_changed. https only — http, file, data, localhost, and private IPs rejected. Caps: 1 MB body, ~10s timeout, max 5 redirects. Returns JSON { url, final_url, content_type, byte_length, sha256, etag?, last_modified?, changed, warnings, body_preview? }. As is, no warranty. Nothing stored.

include_body_if_changed.description: If true and changed (or baseline), include truncated body text (~8KB) as body_preview. Default false.

previous_etag.description: Prior ETag; used when previous_sha256 is absent and response has ETag (quotes normalized).

previous_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of last seen body. If omitted (and no previous_etag match), this call is a baseline (changed=null).

url.description: https URL to watch. http/file/data/localhost/private IPs rejected.

name: url-change-check
